title: Qualify bounded uniform-series first differences and sliding arithmetic means
commitMessage: feat: qualify bounded uniform-series differences and moving averages

contribution.summary: Qualify bounded uniformly sampled first differences and valid-window moving arithmetic means, with explicit positive finite sample interval and typed nonpartial outcomes. Observe one compiled missing-API RED, pass 60 GREEN and 533 retained scientific tests, four Math regressions, and four SHA-equal isolated preview.9 NuGet consumers. Close only S03-T1 R/G/V and T1; keep S03-T2, S03, original C03, M6-W02 and M6 unfinished.
contribution.value: Admit 1..32 finite samples, raw adjacent deltas (not derivatives), complete-window arithmetic means and caller-supplied uniform spacing metadata. Preserve input/output budgets, cancellation, strict interval/window refusals and no implicit time units, forecasting, irregular-time resampling or certified binary64 error bound.
debtChanges: Observe one independently compiled reflection RED for absent public FiniteUniformSeries64 before staging source; compiler failure is not RED evidence.
Recover RED and pass 60 GREEN tests covering [1,3,6] differences [2,3], two-point means [2,4.5], signed inputs and finite 32-point budgets.
Keep first differences as adjacent deltas, not derivatives: return caller-declared positive finite sample interval without numerical division.
Use complete moving-average windows only, length N-window+1; no padding, weighted smoothing, implicit resampling, extrapolation or forecasting.
Refuse null, missing/NaN, nonfinite, out-of-range, nonpositive interval, invalid window and pre-cancelled input with no partial data.
Preserve 69 S02-T2, 60 S02-T1, 53 S01-T2, 25 S01-T1 and 326 C01/C02 scientific tests plus four Math regression projects.
Pack and inspect one actual local scientific preview.9 NuGet assembly/nuspec with SHA-256 and no unsupported foreign package dependency.
Requalify four independently cached eight-probe source-free consumers pinned to preview.9 from cleared local feed with identical package SHA.
Close exactly S03-T1-R/G/V and S03-T1 in backlog and native DWF; S03-T2, S03 phase, parent C03, M6-W02 and M6 remain open.
